gloss: to study; to master; to cultivate

definitions.gloss: to study; to master; to cultivate (learning, conduct)
definitions.explanation: To pursue a field of study to completion, or to cultivate and discipline one's skills or moral conduct. Written {修|おさ}める for the senses of learning and self-cultivation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学業|がくぎょう}→学業：12245_gakugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}める。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}めた。
⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}める⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}めること⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important not only to master learning but also to cultivate one's character.

notes:
A meaning-specific spelling of おさめる for acquiring learning or cultivating oneself. Distinguish from its homophones below.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}める: to master one's studies
- ⟦{学業|がくぎょう}→学業：12245_gakugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}める: to complete an education
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修|おさ}める: to cultivate one's character

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to obtain; to put away — e.g. ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧
- ⟦{治|おさ}める→治める：02462_osameru⟧: to govern; to quell — e.g. ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|おさ}める→治める：02462_osameru⟧
- ⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay in; to deliver — e.g. ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧
